parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Describe the sound you want to create — for example: 'Deep rolling thunder rumbling across the sky with heavy rain pouring on the ground'.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: How long the audio should be, in seconds. Longer clips cost more.

parameters.name: audioFormat
parameters.description: Format of the returned audio file.

next_step.instructions: Optional: prompt_spark rewrites a short or underspecified prompt into an on-model one — pass your draft or the user intent as prompt (model_id is required), then use its recommended_call.parameters as the model_run parameters, as-is or edited. Skip it when the user wants their exact prompt used verbatim.
